sources.text:
Ófærufoss (Icelandic pronunciation: [ˈouːˌfaiːrʏˌfɔsː] ) is a waterfall situated in the Eldgjá chasm in the western part of Vatnajökull National Park, Iceland.  Until the early 1990s a natural bridge spanned the falls, but it collapsed from natural causes.
